question: Which of the following technological companies has launched helicopter services in New York in October 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is **Uber**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Uber** launched a helicopter service in New York in October 2019.
 
• The service is known as **Uber Copter**.
 
• **Uber Copter** offers flights between Manhattan and JFK Airport.
 
• The service aims to reduce travel time significantly compared to traditional road transport.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Aspect
 Description
 
 
 
 

 **Uber**
 A global ride-hailing service company.
 
 

 **Uber Copter**
 An aerial ridesharing service offered by Uber.
 
 

 **Manhattan**
 A borough of New York City where Uber Copter services are available.
 
 

 **JFK Airport**
 One of the major airports in New York, connected by Uber Copter.
 
 

 **Travel Time**
 Uber Copter aims to significantly reduce travel time between Manhattan and JFK Airport.
